title: Single Strain Culture DNA Extractions with Polyzyme
author: Jason Laurich
materials: - Transfer 900 µL to 2 mL Eppendorf tubes with pre-aliquoted 600 µL 100% isopropanol. Use pipettes with tips removed. - Invert gently 50 times! - Pellet DNA at 13,000 RPM for 2 minutes. - Discard isopropanol supernatant. - Wash DNA with 1 mL 70% ethanol. - Centrifuge at 13,000 RPM for 2 minutes. - Pour off as much ethanol as possible. Be careful, the pellet may be loose! - Air dry pellet for at least 15 minutes. This can be done in the safety cabinet, by placing the opening of the tubes over the air flow beneath the glass barrier. - Rehydrate DNA in ~25 µL (depending on volume of DNA, can be increased) Elution buffer (Qiagen) or TE buffer. Use pipettes with tips removed to suspend DNA by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Prepare Liquid Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate cells from agarose plates (preferably from a single colony) into liquid culture and grow them.

substeps.instruction: Culture cells at 27-30 C for 1-4 days.

steps.title: Harvest Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: Collect bacterial cells from the liquid culture via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 1 mL of liquid bacterial culture for 2 minutes at 10,000 RPM in a 1.5+ mL Eppendorf tube.
If cell density is too low, discard supernatant and repeat the process with another 1 mL of culture.

steps.title: Wash Cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Perform a series of PBS washes to clean the cell pellet.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL PBS; vortex.
Centrifuge and discard supernatant.
Repeat the resuspension and centrifugation steps for a total of 3 PBS washes.
Discard final supernatant and resuspend pellet in 150 µL PBS; vortex.

steps.title: Perform Polyzyme Incubation
steps.instruction: Treat the resuspended cells with Polyzyme solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL of Polyzyme solution.
Incubate at 35 C for 4-24 hours.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Break open the cells using lysis solution and heat.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL of lysis solution.
Pipette up and down to suspend cells.
Heat at up to 80 C for up to 10 minutes (especially if samples are dense or cloudy).
Add 1.2 µL of 10 mg/mL RNase A.
Invert gently 2-5 times.
Incubate at 37 C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Precipitate and Remove Proteins
steps.instruction: Remove proteins from the extract using a precipitation solution.

substeps.instruction: Cool sample to room temperature.
Add 250 µL of protein precipitation solution.
Invert gently 2-5 times to mix.
Place on ice for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 10,000 RPM for 10 minutes.
Transfer as much supernatant as possible (~900 µL) to fresh sterile tubes using pipettes with tips removed.
Repeat the protein precipitation process (addition of solution through centrifugation) a second time.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the final DNA concentration using a Qubit or other instrument.
